mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the inspectable record with error recovery was most worthwhile: it distinguished checking how a finding was made from protecting its transmission, without claiming either guarantees truth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final boundary-setting step was the least engaging: its outcome was largely stated in the available ingredients, and it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: Nothing was especially surprising; the useful distinction was that traceability and transmission reliability address different problems.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the link from fictional scholarly apparatus to an inspectable observation record was somewhat abstract.

continue.text: Probably not immediately. The distinctions were useful, but the offered combinations made the short chapter fairly predictable.
